summary: This Form 8-K reports a name change from Avalon GloboCare Corp. to Change Agents Corporation and a corresponding trading symbol change to CHGA, effective July 20, 2026. The amendment required no stockholder approval under Delaware law. This is a routine corporate action with no impact on shareholder rights, CUSIP, or capital structure. There are no acquisition, restructuring, or special-situation elements. Consequently, this filing does not qualify as a special situation event.
